affected_locations: Fukushima Daiichi (Number One) Nuclear Power Plant
key_impacts: Nuclear fuel melted inside the reactors following the accident.
Contaminated coolant water leaked into reactor building basements.
Large volumes of contaminated water accumulated in onsite tanks due to ongoing cooling and ~400 tons/day groundwater inflow.
evidence_snippets: Large-scale nuclear disaster at the TEPCO-operated Fukushima Daiichi Nuclear Power Plant, directly caused by the Great East Japan Earthquake and Tsunami of March 11, 2011.
[Operators] cool the nuclear fuel that melted inside the nuclear reactors due to the accident.
Coolant water becomes extremely contaminated and leaks into the basement... As 400 tons of groundwater are flowing in everyday, the whole site... packed with 1,000 ton capacity tanks.
missing_information: Impacts on population (evacuations, health outcomes, economic losses) not quantified here.
Specific affected settlements beyond the plant site not listed.
End date not specified; accident consequences described as ongoing.
